topic: Staphylococcus aureus aortic valve infective endocarditis complicated by aortic root abscess (new PR prolongation progressing to heart block) and an embolic stroke; the stroke is the presenting complaint and the murmur is subtle

Anti-glomerular basement membrane disease presenting as haemoptysis and rapidly progressive glomerulonephritis in a smoker, initially mistaken for pneumonia; distinguishing from ANCA vasculitis and deciding on plasmapheresis

Acute-on-chronic hypercapnic respiratory failure from obesity hypoventilation syndrome with undiagnosed obstructive sleep apnoea, worsened by opioids and over-oxygenation in the emergency department; distinguishing from COPD

Spontaneous bacterial peritonitis in decompensated alcohol-related cirrhosis with evolving hepatorenal syndrome-AKI; recognising subtle presentation (confusion, no abdominal pain), ascitic fluid interpretation, albumin and antibiotic choice

Secondary haemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis in an adult with persistent fever, cytopenias, splenomegaly and very high ferritin, triggered by EBV-associated lymphoma; distinguishing from sepsis and applying HLH-2004 criteria

Severe Plasmodium falciparum malaria in a returning traveller who took no prophylaxis, presenting with fever, jaundice, thrombocytopenia and confusion; distinguishing from dengue and typhoid, and starting IV artesunate

Primary adrenal insufficiency presenting as hypotension unresponsive to fluids, hyponatraemia and hyperkalaemia in a young woman with autoimmune hypothyroidism recently started on levothyroxine; recognising adrenal crisis and giving hydrocortisone before confirmation

Adult-onset Still's disease in a young adult with quotidian fever, evanescent salmon rash, arthritis, sore throat and very high ferritin after extensive negative infectious workup; Yamaguchi criteria and macrophage activation syndrome as a complication

Herpes simplex encephalitis in an adult with fever, behavioural change, aphasia and a focal seizure; CSF interpretation, temporal lobe changes on MRI, and starting empiric acyclovir with bacterial meningitis cover before results

Hypercalcaemia of malignancy (PTHrP-mediated, squamous lung cancer) presenting as confusion, constipation and AKI in a smoker; distinguishing from primary hyperparathyroidism and myeloma, and acute management with fluids, zoledronic acid and calcitonin
